Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards
Defines the core card and deck abstractions used by the game model.

This package contains the shared base classes for all cards, the two deck implementations used during a match, and the small interfaces that expose common card behavior such as era lookup and drawability checks.
